data.name: Field_RecipientKey_Help
data.value: Paste the recipient's armored PFA PUBLIC KEY block. The block carries both the recipient's X25519 public key (32 bytes) and their WebAuthn credentialId — the guided import on the recipient side uses the credentialId to drive WebAuthn directly to the matching passkey. The export uses ECIES (X25519 + AES-256-GCM) to wrap a fresh per-export key; only the holder of the matching private key can unwrap. No secrets cross between sender and recipient.

data.name: Hint_BackupCard
data.value: An .eds file holds every database, still encrypted, together with the passkey it belongs to. Back one up for yourself, or make one for someone else — only the passkey it was made for can open it.

data.value: Replace everything

data.name: Hint_ReplaceAllWarning
data.value: Both file types here replace every database stored in this browser. Export what you want to keep first — the file is only read once it has been checked, so a damaged file leaves your data untouched, but a good one does replace it.

data.name: Hint_ReplaceAllKinds

data.name: Hint_ReplaceAllKinds_Locked
